description: Registered dispatch returns data.job_id and data.status=queued before operation preflight. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job by that exact id until terminal: job.result is the complete original operation response and job.error retains a failure. Direct internal Python calls keep their complete synchronous results. Admission persists a bounded descriptor; loss of its owner-memory body requires reconciliation without automatic replay. Given root_path and manifest, rehash every declared {repo-relative path: SHA-256} entry beneath the absolute directory and return exact, mismatch, or missing for each file. Each manifest path and digest is validated before the file is read. Paths are confined to the root, including through symlinks. The verb also reports when a scratch worktree's .venv or editable-install pointer resolves source outside that root, the worktree-shadowing class tracked by iss_60621400. It never stages, commits, merges, or otherwise mutates Git.
embedding_description: Compare declared SHA-256 digests with files beneath a candidate root. Find missing or changed files and editable-install pointers that resolve outside the root before relying on a captured tree. Reports exact, missing and mismatched paths.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Submission: data.job_id and data.status. Terminal job.result: Object with root_path, files [{path, expected_sha256, actual_sha256|null, status}], all_exact, editable_install_warnings, and editable_install_shadowing_detected.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with all_exact and any missing/mismatch paths. Surface editable_install_shadowing_detected prominently: a true value means a Python gate may have imported code from outside the declared root.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Keep the exact job id. Retrieve job_service.get_job until terminal before consuming operation fields; do not repeat effects after owner loss or an uncertain terminal write. This is evidence only. Do not infer landing authorization or mutate Git from a passing result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reading declared files and Python editable-install pointers under an absolute worktree/candidate-tree root.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError means the root, manifest digest, or declared relative path was invalid or escaped the root. A per-file missing or mismatch is returned as a normal report result, not an invocation error.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Correct the root/path/digest declaration and rerun. For a mismatch or missing path, repair the candidate manifest or file surface; for editable-install warnings, run the gate using a venv whose pointers resolve into the declared root.
